z-m-04-01.title: Ikhadi elilandelayo elikhishwayo lingaba yini?
z-m-04-01.topic: Ukwenzeka: ukusho ukuthi yini engavela nokuthi yini engenakuvela
z-m-04-01.goal: Njalo uma ikhadi likhishwa, misa futhi usho 'lingavela / alikwazi ukuvela / kumele livele' ngesizathu.
z-m-04-01.material: Ebhokisini kunamakhadi enombolo angu-6, kubhalwe u-1, 2, 3, 4, 5, no-6, elilodwa ngalinye. Okungemuva kwamakhadi konke kuyafana, ngakho udweba elilodwa ngesikhathi uvale amehlo. Ngemva kokuhlola ingaphambili lekhadi elidwetshiwe, ulibeka eceleni futhi ungalibuyiseli ebhokisini. Izaziso ezingezansi zivulwa ngesisodwa ngesikhathi.
z-m-04-01.thinking.2: Ukungabaza izizathu ezizwakala ngokunengqondo njengosayizi noma ukulandelana
z-m-04-01.prereq.0: Ukwazi izinombolo kusukela ku-1 kuya ku-10 nokwahlukanisa i-odd ne-even (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-04-01.s.s1.prompt: Izaziso zivulwa ngesisodwa ngesikhathi. Isikhathi ngasinye, khetha isitatimende esilungile.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kusaziso ngasinye, qala ubhale 'yimaphi amakhadi asele ebhokisini manje'.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ukuthi isitatimende osikhethile silungile ngempela ngokusebenza, kukhadi ngalinye elisele, ukuthi lingavela yini.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Alikho ikhadi elikhishwe okwamanje. Cabanga ngekhadi lokuqala ozolidweba.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Wonke amakhadi asebhokisini angavela, futhi ikhadi elingekho ebhokisini, njenge-7, alikwazi ukuvela. Awukwazi ukunquma kusengaphambili ukuthi yiliphi ikhadi elizovela.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ubone ukuthi kukhona u-5 ebhokisini, ngakho ungavela. Kuhle ukubheka amakhadi akhona kuqala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ebhokisini kunamakhadi 1 kuya ku-6 kuphela. Bheka futhi ukuthi ikhadi elingekho ebhokisini lingavela yini.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uma udweba uvale amehlo, awukwazi ukunquma kusengaphambili ukuthi liyoba yiliphi ikhadi. 'Kungavela' no-'kumele kuvele' kuhlukile.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ikhadi elivelayo lilodwa lika-1 kuya ku-6
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Udlule kuwo wonke amakhadi asebhokisini futhi washo ibanga lalokho okungavela. Awunqumanga inombolo.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Udwebe amakhadi amabili futhi wathola u-5 no-2. Ubeke amakhadi amabili eceleni futhi awabuyiselanga ebhokisini. Manje cabanga ngekhadi lesithathu ozolidweba.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.after: U-5 no-2 baphumile ebhokisini futhi abaphindi bangene. Ngakho u-5 akasakwazi ukuvela, futhi amakhadi asele 1, 3, 4, no-6 wonke angavela. Ulwazi olusha lushintshe owodwa wemicabango yokuqala.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ucabange isimo njengoba sasinjalo ekuqaleni. Bheka lapho u-5 ukhona manje.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: U-5 no-2 baphumile, ngakho kulokhu kuyisikhathi sika-1 ngokulandelana
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Alikho 'ithuba' elimisiwe. Uma udweba uvale amehlo, wonke amakhadi asele angavela.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubheke kuphela amakhadi asele ebhokisini, wasusa amakhadi abekwe eceleni. Usebenzise ulwazi olusha esahlulelweni sakho.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: U-5 no-2 sebevele kakade, ngakho kulokhu u-6 kumele avele
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ngoba amanye amakhadi sewavele, ikhadi elilandelayo alinqunyiwe. Bheka ukuthi mangaki amakhadi asele.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.info: U-4 uvele njengekhadi lesithathu. Ubeke u-4 eceleni nawo. Manje amakhadi amathathu, u-1, 3, no-6, asele ebhokisini.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Khetha isitatimende esilungile ngekhadi lesine ozolidweba.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Phakathi kwamakhadi asele 1, 3, 6, kukhona i-odd (1, 3) ne-even (6). Ngakho kokubili kungavela. Noma kunamakhadi ambalwa, kusiyiqiniso ukuthi awukwazi ukunquma kusengaphambili ukuthi yiliphi ikhadi elizovela.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hlola ngalinye ukuthi ikhona yini inombolo ye-even phakathi kwamakhadi asele.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: U-6 uyinombolo enkulu kakhulu, ngakho u-6 uyaye avele kakhulu
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Inombolo enkulu ayidwebeki kalula. Okungemuva kwamakhadi konke kuyafana futhi udweba uvale amehlo.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: U-4 ubekwe eceleni. Hlola ukuthi u-4 ukhona yini ebhokisini manje.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ikhadi le-odd nekhadi le-even kungavela kokubili
z-m-04-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ubheke iqiniso lokuthi kukhona izinombolo ze-odd ne-even phakathi kuka-1, 3, 6 osele.
z-m-04-01.s.s1.reflect: Umcabango wakho wokuthi u-5 ungavela washintsha kanjani ngemva kokuba u-5 ebekwe eceleni? Futhi yisiphi isitatimende esahlala sifana ngisho nangemva kokudwetshwa kwamanye amakhadi?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.prompt: Umngani wathi, "Amakhadi asele ngu-1, 3, no-6, ngakho omkhulu, u-6, uzovela!" Ubungathanda ukusho ini kulo mngani?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.0: Cabanga ukuthi kulungile yini ukushintsha "uzovela" emazwini omngani wakho kube "ungavela".
z-m-04-01.s.s2.hint.1: Sebenza ukuthi kungenzeka ngempela yini ukuthi ikhadi elingelona u-6 livele phakathi kwamakhadi amathathu asele.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe umehluko phakathi kwe-'ungavela' ne-'kumele avele' ubonakala kulokho engikushilo?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe ucabange ngeqiniso lokuthi amanye amakhadi phakathi kuka-1, 3, 6 asele angavela nawo?
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.0: U-6 ungavela, kodwa akadingeki. U-1 noma u-3 ungavela.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.1: Inombolo enkulu ayivi kalula. Udweba uvale amehlo, ngakho awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi yiliphi ikhadi elizovela.
z-m-04-01.s.s2.model.2: U-6 ungaphuma, kodwa akadingeki. U-1 noma u-3 nabo bangaphuma.

z-m-04-03.title: Ichashaza elilodwa lifihla ibhokisi elilodwa
z-m-04-03.topic: Idatha efihliwe ethebuleni: yini enye esiyidingayo ukuyithola?
z-m-04-03.goal: Khetha ulwazi oludingekayo ukuthola ibhokisi elilodwa lethebula (inani eliphelele, ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ukhethe into eyodwa kuphela), bese usho ukuthi impendulo iguquka kanjani uma kufika ulwazi olusha.
z-m-04-03.material: Abangane ekilasini lethu ngamunye bakhethe uhlobo olulodwa lwesithuthi abalithandayo. Upende ushaye ibhokisi elilodwa lethebula lenhlolovo, ngakho alibonakali. [Ithebula] Imoto 6 / Isitimela □ (akubonakali) / Indiza 4 / Umkhumbi 2. Ufuna ukwazi inombolo engena ebhokisini elingenalutho (□).
z-m-04-03.thinking.2: Ukulungisa isahlulelo sakho ngokufaka ulwazi olusha
z-m-04-03.prereq.0: Ukwengeza nokukhipha izinombolo kuze kube ngu-20 (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-04-03.prereq.1: Ukufunda inani labantu ebhokisini ngalinye lethebula
z-m-04-03.s.s1.prompt: Yini enye odinga ukuyazi ukuthola inombolo engena ku-□? Khetha zonke ezilungile.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokuhlola zonke izinombolo emabhokisini aziwayo ethebuleni.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi leyo nombolo kumele ihlobane kanjani nekilasi lonke.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.a: Ukuthi abangu-4 abakhethe indiza basegameni liphi
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.a: Ukuthi ngubani osegameni liphi akunakho ukuhlobana nenombolo ku-□. Bheka futhi ulwazi odinga ukunquma inombolo.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.b: Ukuthi abangane abakhethe isitimela bayinde yini
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.b: Ukuphakama akunakho ukuhlobana nenombolo ku-□. Cabanga ukuthi yilulwazi luni olungakuvumela ukunquma inombolo.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.c: Uzamile ukufanisa isamba sethebula namabhokisi aziwayo.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.d: Ukuthi izinombolo ezinkulungwaneni ezintathu ezaziwayo (imoto, indiza, umkhumbi) zilungile yini
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.d: Izinombolo emabhokisini aziwayo sezivele ethebuleni. Ukunquma u-□, udinga ulwazi olungekho ethebuleni.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.o.e: Ukuthi umuntu ngamunye ukhethe into eyodwa kuphela yini
z-m-04-03.s.s1.r.e: Uzamile ukuhlola ukuthi akekho ovela emabhokisini amabili.
z-m-04-03.s.s1.explain: Uma wazi inani eliphelele labantu ekilasini nokuthi umuntu ngamunye ukhethe into eyodwa kuphela, inombolo esele ngemuva kokususa amabhokisi amathathu aziwayo ngu-□. Ukwazi ukuphakama noma igama lomngane okhethe isitimela, noma ukuhlola futhi nje amabhokisi aziwayo, akukwazi ukunquma u-□.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.prompt: Uthisha wakutshela. "Sikhona abangu-15 ekilasini lethu. Omunye umngane akazange afike namuhla, ngakho asikwazanga ukwenza inhlolovo kuye. Wonke abangane abenziwa inhlolovo bakhethe into eyodwa kuphela." U-□ ungaki?
z-m-04-03.s.s2.hint.0: Umngane ongekho akavezi noma yikuphi ethebuleni. Qala ngokunquma ukuthi bangaki abantu okumele bavele ethebuleni.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qhathanisa leyo nombolo nezinombolo emabhokisini amathathu aziwayo.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.a: Kubukeka sengathi usebenzise ikilasi lonke elingu-15 njengoba linjalo. Hlola ulwazi lokuthi kukhona umngane ongenziwanga inhlolovo kuye.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.b: Manje usuyazi inani eliphelele labantu nokuthi ngamunye ukhethe into eyodwa kuphela. Hlola futhi ukuthi lolo lwazi lukuvumela yini ukunquma u-□.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.c: Ufanise amabhokisi aziwayo nenani labantu abenziwa inhlolovo. Usebenzise ulwazi lokuthi umngane akazange afike.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.r.d: Hlola lokho owakushiya ngenkathi ubala izinombolo emabhokisini aziwayo.
z-m-04-03.s.s2.explain: Abangane abenziwa inhlolovo bangu-14, okungu-15 kususwe u-1 ongekho. Amabhokisi aziwayo angu-6 + 4 + 2 = 12, ngakho u-□ ngu-14 − 12 = 2.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.prompt: Uma omunye umngane engabikho, bangaki abangane ababezokhetha isitimela? Bhala ukuthi wazi kanjani.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.hint.0: Funda futhi ukuthi isamba obesisetshenziswe nje ukuthola u-□ besingaki.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.hint.1: Qala ngokusho ukuthi kwenzekani kuleso samba uma omunye umngane engekho.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingabe izinombolo engizibhalile zisebenzise zombili izinombolo emabhokisini amathathu aziwayo nenani labantu abenziwa inhlolovo?
z-m-04-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uchaze ukuthi kungani u-□ kuphela oguquka, hhayi amanye amabhokisi, uma omunye umngane engekho?
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.0: 1. Abangane abenziwa inhlolovo bancipha ngo-1 baba ngu-13, ngakho ngemuva kokuhlanganisa ezaziwayo ezingu-6, 4, no-2, okusele ngu-1.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.modelNote.0: Kuchazwa ngo-13 kususwe u-12 obalwe wonke emabhokisini aziwayo, inombolo esele
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.1: Kunye. Isamba sehle ngo-1 kodwa amanye amabhokisi asala njengoba enjalo, ngakho ibhokisi lesitimela lehla ngo-1.
z-m-04-03.s.s3.model.2: Umuntu o-1. Inani labantu abenziwa inhlolovo liba ngu-13 futhi amabhokisi aziwayo angu-12, ngakho 13-12=1.

z-m-04-02.title: Uma ngibala, izinombolo zabangani ababili ziyahluka
z-m-04-02.topic: Ukubala ngaphandle kokushiya: ukuthola lapho ukubala kwaphutha khona
z-m-04-02.goal: Uma ukubala kwabantu ababili kuhlukile, sebenzisa inombolo emgqeni ngamunye njengobufakazi, funda ukuthi kungenzeka akekho olungile, uthole iphutha, bese usho indlela yokubala evimbela iphutha elifanayo.
z-m-04-02.material: Etafuleni kunamasitikha enkanyezi afanayo emigqeni emithathu. Umugqa ophezulu unamasitikha angu-5, umugqa ophakathi unamasitikha angu-6, futhi umugqa ongezansi unamasitikha angu-5. UJihu noNari babala ukuthi kunamasitikha amangaki ngokuphelele. UJihu wathi 15, futhi uNari wathi 17. Ufuna ukuthola ukuthi ngowaliphi phakathi kwabangane ababili olungile.
z-m-04-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlola ngobufakazi (inombolo emgqeni ngamunye) uma imiphumela ihlukile
z-m-04-02.thinking.2: Ukucabanga ngezindlela zokuvimbela ukushiya nokubala kabili
z-m-04-02.prereq.0: Ukubala izinombolo kuze kube ngu-20 ngokulandelana (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-04-02.prereq.1: Ukubala umugqa ngamunye ngokuhlukile futhi ubhale phansi
z-m-04-02.s.s1.prompt: Bheka izinombolo ezibalwe abangane ababili bese ukhetha isitatimende esilungile.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala ukuthi kunangaki emgqeni ngamunye.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi isamba sokubala yonke imigqa emithathu siyafana yini nezinombolo ezibalwe abangane ababili.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.a: Inombolo encane ayiyona njalo ilungile. Hlola ukuthi kwenzekani uma uhlanganisa izinombolo emgqeni ngamunye.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.b: Uhlole zombili izinombolo usebenzisa inombolo emgqeni ngamunye.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.c: Ucabange ukuthi lowo obale okuningi akashiyanga lutho. Kodwa ungabala nesitikha esifanayo kabili.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.r.d: Inombolo emgqeni ngamunye isivele yaziwa. Bheka futhi ukuthi ungahlola yini ngaleyo.
z-m-04-02.s.s1.explain: Uma ubala umugqa ophezulu u-5, umugqa ophakathi u-6, nomugqa ongezansi u-5, kunabangu-16. Akusiwo u-15 owabalwa uJihu noma u-17 owabalwa uNari olungile. Bobabili abangane baphutha endaweni ethile ngenkathi bebala.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.prompt: Nanku indlela uJihu ababale ngayo ngokuzwakalayo. Khetha umugqa ophosile.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bala ukuthi kubalwe angaki emgqeni ngamunye bese uqhathanisa nenombolo eyaziwayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.1: Emazwini asetshenziselwa ukubala umugqa ongezansi, khomba ngomunwe ukubona ukuthi kubalwe angaki.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.0: Wabala umugqa ophezulu kusukela kwesobunxele: kunye, kubili, kuthathu, kune, kuhlanu.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.1: Wabala umugqa ophakathi kusukela kwesobunxele, eqhubeka: isithupha, isikhombisa, isishiyagalombili, isishiyagalolunye, ishumi, ishumi nanye.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.2: Wabala umugqa ongezansi kusukela kwesobunxele, eqhubeka: ishumi nambili, ishumi nantathu, ishumi nane, ishumi nanhlanu.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.line.3: Inombolo yokugcina ebaliwe ishumi nanhlanu, ngakho kunabangu-15 ngokuphelele.
z-m-04-02.s.s2.explain: Umugqa 3 uphosile. Umugqa ongezansi unamasitikha angu-5, kodwa wabala angu-4 kuphela: ishumi nambili, ishumi nantathu, ishumi nane, ishumi nanhlanu. Ishumi nesithupha lashiywa. Imigqa 1 no-2 ibalwe ukuze ifane nenombolo emgqeni ngamunye, futhi umugqa 4 waphinda nje inombolo yokugcina eyabalwa ngaphambili, ngakho akuyona iphutha lendlela yokubala uqobo.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.prompt: UNari wathi 17. Qagela lapho uNari kungenzeka waphutha khona, bese ubhala indlela yokubala engavimbela iphutha elifanayo.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubheka ukuthi u-17 mkhulu noma mncane kuno-16, bese ucabanga ukuthi kukhona okushiyiwe noma okwengeziwe okubaliwe.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi uphawu luni kulabo obabalile olungakuvimbela ukubala isitikha esifanayo kabili.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Uma ngisebenzisa indlela engiyibhalile, ingavimbela yini kokubili iphutha likaJihu neliphutha likaNari?
z-m-04-02.s.s3.model.0: Kubonakala sengathi inkanyezi efanayo ibalwe kabili. Uma ubala ngenkathi wenza uphawu oluncane ezinkanyezini obabalile, ngeke ubale kabili noma ushiye.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.model.1: Kubonakala sengathi okukodwa kubalwe kanye ngaphezulu phakathi komugqa ophakathi nomugqa ongezansi. Uma ubala umugqa ngamunye ngokuhlukile futhi ubhale phansi, bese uwuxhumanisa kamuva, ungathola umugqa ophosile.
z-m-04-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ukubala umugqa ngamunye futhi ubhale phansi

z-m-04-04.title: Ingabe 'okuningi' kuhlala kuhlula wonke asele?
z-m-04-04.topic: Ukwenza isibonelo esiphikisayo: ukuqhathanisa into ekhethwe kakhulu nawo wonke asele ndawonye
z-m-04-04.goal: Yenza ithebula lapho isitatimende esithi 'umsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu uhlala unabaningi kunawo wonke amanye ahlangene' singasebenzi, bese usho isimo lapho isitatimende siba silungile.
z-m-04-04.material: Abangane abangu-12 bakhethe umsebenzi abafuna ukuwenza epikinikini. Imisebenzi ukuzingela umcebo, ukweqa intambo, nemidlalo yebhola. Bonke abangu-12 bakhethe into eyodwa kuphela. UHayun wathi, "Umsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu uhlala unabangane abaningi kunalabo abakhethe eminye imisebenzi emibili ndawonye!" Cabanga ukuthi kukhona umsebenzi owodwa kuphela okhethwe kakhulu, futhi awubopheki nomunye umsebenzi.
z-m-04-04.prereq.0: Ukwengeza izinombolo kuze kube ngu-12 (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-04-04.s.s1.prompt: Isitatimende sikaHayun sihlala silungile? Ngaphambi kokwenza ithebula, khetha umcabango wakho.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.hint.0: Faka inombolo encane eyodwa bese ubhala icala elilodwa.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.hint.1: Beka eceleni komunye inombolo yomsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu nenombolo oyithola ngokwengeza eminye imisebenzi emibili.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.a: Kuhlala kulungile. Umsebenzi okhethwe kakhulu unabaningi kunemisebenzi eminye
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.a: 'Abaningi kunomsebenzi ngamunye omunye' no-'abaningi kunawo wonke asele ahlangene' akusho into efanayo.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.o.b: Akubonakali kuhlala kulungile. Ngizohlola ngokufaka izinombolo
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.b: Ubonile ukuthi isitatimende sithi 'njalo', ngakho kufanele sihlolwe. Kuyisimo sengqondo sokuhlola ngezinombolo.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.r.c: Inani labantu linqunyiwe. Cabanga ukuthi ungathola yini ngokufaka inombolo.
z-m-04-04.s.s1.explain: Igama elithi 'njalo' lingaphulwa ngisho nangesibonelo esisodwa. Ungathola ngokuhlola ngethebula olenza wena. Umfundi othe 'angazi' ekuqaleni naye angahlulela ngemuva kokwenza ithebula.

z-m-04-08.topic: 'Okwengeziwe kakhulu' kushintsha ngokwezinga: umbala, ukwakheka, uhlobo
z-m-04-08.goal: Funda ukuthi uma uhlunga izinkinobho ezifanayo ngombala, ngesimo, noma ngohlobo lubala umbala nesimo ndawonye, 'okwengeziwe kakhulu' kungahluka, bese ukhetha izinga elifanelana nombuzo futhi wenze umbuzo omusha.
z-m-04-08.material: Esitolo senkinobho kunezinkinobho eziyi-12. Inkinobho ngayinye ingomunye wemibala obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, noma mpunga, futhi inesimo sesiyingi noma unxantathu. [Itafula] Isiyingi esibomvu 2 / Unxantathu obomvu 3 / Isiyingi oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 4 / Unxantathu oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 0 / Isiyingi esimpunga 1 / Unxantathu ompunga 2. Ndawonye benza u-12. UMinjun wabala ngombala futhi wabala nangesimo.
z-m-04-08.thinking.0: Ukuhlunga idatha efanayo ngamazinga amaningi futhi uqhathanise
z-m-04-08.thinking.1: Ukwahlukanisa lokho izinga ngalinye likutshela kona nalokho lingakutsheli
z-m-04-08.s.s1.prompt: Nansi indlela uMinjun acabanga ngayo. Khetha umugqa onephutha.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.hint.0: Thola futhi ufunde inombolo ebhokisini 'lesiyingi esibomvu' etafuleni.
z-m-04-08.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi yiliphi kumabhokisi ayisithupha elinenombolo enkulu kakhulu.

z-m-04-05.title: Inhlolovo yemibala ethandwayo: sidinga amabhokisi anjani?
z-m-04-05.topic: Ukunquma izinto zenhlolovo: ukwenza amabhokisi abantu bonke abangawaphawula ngaphandle kokushiya muntu
z-m-04-05.goal: Funda inkinga evela uma ibhokisi lenhlolovo lingenaso into, yenza amabhokisi wena ukuze umngane ngamunye akwazi ukuphawula ibhokisi elilodwa, bese usho umkhawulo webhokisi elisha elivelayo.
z-m-04-05.material: Abafundi abangu-20 eklasini kaMinho benza ucwaningo 'lombala owodwa othandwa kakhulu'. Umuntu ngamunye uphawula ibhokisi elilodwa kuphela. UMinho wenze amabhokisi amathathu kuphela efomini lokucwaninga: 'obomvu', 'oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka', no-'mpunga'.
z-m-04-05.prereq.0: Ukuphawula nokubala emabhokisini ahlukaniswe etafuleni (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-04-05.prereq.1: Ukuqonda umbandela wokuthi umuntu ngamunye ukhetha into eyodwa kuphela
z-m-04-05.s.s1.prompt: Uma abantu abangu-20 bephawula la mabhokisi amathathu kuphela, kungenzeka ini?
z-m-04-05.s.s1.hint.1: Hlola ngayinye ukuthi umbala ngamunye uphakathi kwamabhokisi amathathu.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.a: Uma ubala zonke izimpawu emabhokisini amathathu, kumele zibe ngu-20
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.a: Kungaba nabangani abangenayo ibhokisi lokuphawula. Qala usebenze ukuthi bonke abangani bangakhetha ibhokisi yini.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.b: Umngani onombala awuthanda kakhulu uluhlaza akanayo ibhokisi lokuphawula
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.b: Ngifanise imibala abangani abayithandayo namabhokisi etafula locwaningo ngalinye.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.c: Kunamabhokisi amathathu kuphela, ngakho ucwaningo alukwazi ukwenziwa nhlobo
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba namabhokisi ambalwa akusho ukuthi ucwaningo alukwazi ukwenziwa. Bheka ukuthi amabhokisi aba yinkinga ngempela nini.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.o.d: Obomvu uzothola izimpawu eziningi, ngakho amanye amabhokisi awadingeki
z-m-04-05.s.s1.r.d: Uqagela umphumela wamabhokisi kusengaphambili. Okwamanje, into yokuqala ukuthi bonke abangani bangaphawula yini.
z-m-04-05.s.s1.explain: Uma kunamabhokisi amathathu kuphela, umngani onombala awuthanda kakhulu ongeyona eyodwa yamathathu, njengoluhlaza noma ophephuli, akanayo ibhokisi lokuphawula. Khona-ke noma ubala zonke izimpawu, kungase kungafinyeleli ku-20.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.prompt: Kufanele wenze kanjani amabhokisi ukuze bonke abantu abangu-20 baphawule umbala abawuthanda kakhulu? Bhala amagama amabhokisi, futhi ubhale nokuthi kungani uwenze ngaleyo ndlela.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.hint.0: Uma phakathi kwabangu-20 kukhona umngani onombala awuthanda kakhulu ongeyona obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, noma mpunga, cabanga ukuthi uzophawula ibhokisi elingaliphi.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.hint.1: Uma wenza ibhokisi elilodwa elengeziwe, bhala ukuthi lidinga ligama elini ukuze wonke umuntu aphawule.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.placeholder: Isibonelo: Ngaphandle kwamabhokisi obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, no-mpunga, ngenza ibhokisi elithi ... Ngoba ...
z-m-04-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Emabhokisini engiwenzile, bonke abantu abangu-20 bangaphawula ibhokisi elilodwa?
z-m-04-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ingabe likhona icala lapho umuntu oyedwa kumele aphawule amabhokisi amabili?
z-m-04-05.s.s2.model.0: Ngizokwenza amabhokisi obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, mpunga, oluhlaza, nemibala 'emibalweni eminye'. Uma kukhona ibhokisi elithi 'eminye imibala', noma ubani angaphawula noma umbala awuthanda ungowuphi.
z-m-04-05.s.s2.model.1: Qala ubuze abangani imibala abayithanda kakhulu, futhi wenze ibhokisi lombala ngamunye ovelayo. Khona-ke akukho mngani ongakwazi ukukhetha ngoba kungekho ibhokisi.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.prompt: UMinho wamisa amabhokisi ku-'obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, mpunga, oluhlaza, eminye imibala' futhi wenza ucwaningo ngabantu abangu-20. Umphumela ngu-obomvu 4, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 4, mpunga 3, oluhlaza 3, neminye imibala 6. UJisu wathi, "Eminye imibala inayo 6, ekhulu kakhulu, ngakho eminye imibala iyombala othandwa kakhulu." Isitatimende sikaJisu kumele silungiswe kanjani?
z-m-04-05.s.s3.hint.0: Bhala imibala embalwa engangena ebhokisini lemibala eminye.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ngecala lapho bonke abangu-6 bakhethe umbala ofanayo nalapho bonke abangu-6 bakhethe imibala ehlukene.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.a: Kunjalo. U-6 yinombolo enkulu kakhulu, ngakho eminye imibala iyombala othandwa kakhulu
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.a: Uqhathanise kuphela izinombolo ezisemabhokisini. Qala ucabange ukuthi 'eminye imibala' umbala owodwa yini.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.b: Susa ibhokisi lemibala eminye futhi uthi obomvu noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka bayizimbala ezithandwa kakhulu
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.b: Noma ususa ibhokisi, abangu-6 abakhethe eminye imibala abanyamalali. Awukwazi ukwazi ukuthi leso-6 sakhetha imiphi imibala.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.c: Kunamabhokisi amahlanu, ngakho lo mphumela awukwazi ukwethenjwa
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba namabhokisi ambalwa noma amaningi akusho ukuthi umphumela awukwazi ukwethenjwa. Bheka ukuthi ulwazi luni amabhokisi alunikezayo.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.o.d: "Eminye imibala" ibhokisi lapho imibala eminingi ixutshwe, ngakho ayikwazi ukubizwa ngokuthi umbala owodwa
z-m-04-05.s.s3.r.d: Ubone ukuthi imibala eminingi ihlangene ebhokisini elilodwa. Ubheke iphuzu lokuthi asikwazi ukusho ukuthi bonke abantu abangu-6 ebhokisini banombala ofanayo yini.
z-m-04-05.s.s3.explain: 'Eminye imibala' ingaqukatha imibala eminingana ndawonye, njengophephuli nompompi. Uma abangu-6 ngamunye bekhethe umbala ohlukile, umbala owodwa ungaba nomuntu o-1 kuphela, futhi uma bonke abangu-6 bekhethe umbala ofanayo, umbala owodwa ungaba nabantu abangu-6. Lelitafula lodwa alikwazi ukusho ukuthi yikuphi, ngakho udinga ukubuza labo abangu-6 futhi ukuthi umbala muni.

z-m-04-06.topic: Ukuqhathanisa izibalo zamasethi amabili edatha: ukuqhathanisa ngokubhangqanisa nangokubala ngokwehlukana

z-m-04-06.material: Abangani eklasini ngamunye bakhethe isilwane esisodwa abasithanda kakhulu, uphuphu noma ikati. Umngani okhethe uphuphu ukhonjiswa nge-○ (isiyingi), futhi umngani okhethe ikati ukhonjiswa nge-△ (unxantathu). Abangani abangu-8 bakhethe uphuphu futhi abangani abangu-5 bakhethe ikati. USeohyeon wabeka umugqa we-○ nomugqa we-△ eceleni komunye, ngaphezulu nangaphansi.

z-m-04-07.title: Kube nezinsuku eziningi ezinelanga kuleli sonto, ngakho ngabe isonto elilandelayo lizoba njalo?
z-m-04-07.topic: Lokho amarekhodi angakusho nalokho angenakukusho: ukuqagela okuzokwenzeka okulandelayo
z-m-04-07.goal: Funda ukuthi kusukela emarekhodini adlule ungasho ukuthi yini 'eyayiningi kakhulu', kodwa awukwazi ukusho ngokuqinisekile ukuthi kuzokwenzeka ini okulandelayo, futhi usho ukuthi ukuqagela kwakho kushintsha kanjani uma unamarekhodi amaningi.
z-m-04-07.material: Warekhoda isimo sezulu kukhalenda lekilasi izinsuku ezi-5, kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya ngoLwesihlanu. Kuleli sonto bekunezinsuku ezingu-3 ezinelanga, usuku o-1 olunamafu, nosuku o-1 olunemvula. UYeonseo wathi, "Bekunezinsuku ezinelanga eziningi kakhulu kuleli sonto, ngakho isonto elilandelayo kuzoba nezinsuku ezinelanga eziningi kakhulu nakho."
z-m-04-07.thinking.0: Ukwahlukanisa lokho amarekhodi angakusho nalokho angenakukusho
z-m-04-07.thinking.1: Ukulungisa ukuthi uqiniseka kangakanani njengoba idatha ikhula
z-m-04-07.prereq.0: Ukwengeza izinombolo kuze kufike ku-5 nokufunda inani lezinsuku etafuleni (izinga leBanga 1)
z-m-04-07.prereq.1: Amagama esimo sezulu afana nelanga, amafu, imvula
z-m-04-07.s.s1.hint.0: Qhathanisa ukuthi iqiniso lokuthi izinsuku ezinelanga bezingenhlobonhlobo erekhodini yeleli sonto nesimo sezulu sesonto elilandelayo kuyisitatimende esifanayo yini.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi kungaba kuhluke kanjani uma kunamarekhodi esimo sezulu samanye amasonto.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.a: Usebenzise amarekhodi adlule njengomkhondo kodwa awuzange ukhukhumeze ukuthola isiphetho. Ungacabanga ngokuthi izinto zingashintsha kanjani uma kwakukhona amarekhodi amaningi.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.b: Amarekhodi eleli sonto asitshela lutho ngesonto elilandelayo
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.b: Amarekhodi eleli sonto awanqumi isonto elilandelayo, kodwa kuyadabukisa ukusho ukuthi akukho mkhondo nhlobo. Umkhondo nokuqiniseka kuyizinto ezihlukile.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.o.c: Beyinjalo kuleli sonto, ngakho isonto elilandelayo lizoba njalo ngokuqinisekile
z-m-04-07.s.s1.r.c: Uthathe amarekhodi esonto elilodwa wawadlulisela ngqo kwelilandelayo. Amanye amasonto ngabe ayehluke.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.explain: Irekhodi leli sonto ngumkhondo wokuthi kungaba nezinsuku eziningi ezinelanga ngesonto elilandelayo. Kodwa ngerekhodi lesonto elilodwa kuphela, awukwazi ukusho 'ngokuqinisekile' ukuthi kuzoba njalo.
z-m-04-07.s.s1.acc.0: Ubone kahle ukuthi irekhodi lesonto elilodwa alikwazi ukunquma isonto elilandelayo. Kodwa ukuthi irekhodi lisebenza njengomkhondo kungasetshenzwa ngenkathi kuqoqwa amaningi.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.prompt: UYeonseo wathola nerekhodi leleso sonto elidlule. Isonto elidlule bekuyizinsuku ezi-2 ezinelanga, usuku o-1 olunamafu, nezinsuku ezi-2 ezinemvula. Uma uhlanganisa amasonto amabili (izinsuku eziyi-10), kunezinsuku ezi-5 ezinelanga, ezi-2 ezinamafu, nezi-3 ezinemvula. Khetha isitatimende esilungile.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bala futhi izinsuku zamasonto amabili ngesimo sezulu futhi uzibhale etafuleni.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala ngokwehlukana lokho ongakusho kumarekhodi nalokho ongakwazi ngesonto elilandelayo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.a: Izinsuku ezinelanga bezizinengi kakhulu, ngakho isonto elilandelayo kuzoba nezinsuku ezinelanga eziningi kakhulu ngokuqinisekile nakho
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.a: Noma uqoqe amarekhodi ezinsuku eziyi-10, isonto elilandelayo alikafiki. Lapho uqoqa kakhulu, uba nemikhondo eminingi, kodwa awukwazi ukusho ngokuqinisekile.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.b: Izinsuku ezinelanga bezizinengi kakhulu, kodwa asikwazi ukwazi ngesonto elilandelayo
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.b: Uhlukanise lokho amarekhodi angakusho (bekungu-okuningi kakhulu) nalokho angenakukusho (isonto elilandelayo).
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.c: Qhathanisa futhi izinsuku ezi-5 ezinelanga nezinsuku ezi-3 ezinemvula.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.o.d: Siqoqe izinsuku eziyi-10, ngakho isonto elilandelayo kuzoba nezinsuku ezi-3 ngqo ezinelanga
z-m-04-07.s.s2.r.d: Uthathe umlinganiselo wamarekhodi adlule wawudlulisela ngqo esontweni elilandelayo. Noma amarekhodi ekhula, awukwazi ukunquma inani eliqondile lezinsuku zesonto elilandelayo.
z-m-04-07.s.s2.explain: Erekhodini lezinsuku eziyi-10, ungasho ukuthi izinsuku ezinelanga bezizinengi kakhulu, ngezinsuku ezi-5. Kodwa isimo sezulu sesonto elilandelayo asikenzeki, ngakho asikwazi ukunqunywa. Njengoba amarekhodi ekhula, umkhondo wokuthi kungaba nezinsuku eziningi ezinelanga uyathembeka kancane.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala ukuthi ungasho ini ngesimo sezulu sesonto elilandelayo kusukela kudatha onayo manje, nokuthi yini esengaqiniseki. Bhala nokuthi yimaphi amanye amarekhodi angakwenza uthembe kakhulu lesi sitatimende.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.hint.0: Bheka ukuthi amasonto anezinsuku ezinelanga eziningi kakhulu ayefana yini erekhodini yeleli sonto neyesonto eledlule.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.hint.1: Cabanga ukuthi ungafunda ini okunye uma uqoqa uhlobo olufanayo lwerekhodi amanye amasonto ambalwa.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kulokho engikushilo, ingabe 'lokho esingakwazi kudatha yamanje' no-'lokho esingakakwazi okwamanje' kuhlukanisiwe?
z-m-04-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingabe amarekhodi engithe aqoqwe kakhulu angasiza ekuqageleni isimo sezulu sesonto elilandelayo?
z-m-04-07.s.s3.model.0: Izinsuku ezinelanga zingaba ezinengi kakhulu, kodwa akudingeki. Uma siqoqa amarekhodi amasonto amaningi, singathemba kakhulu.
z-m-04-07.s.s3.model.1: Asikwazi ukwazi okwamanje. Amasonto amabili kuphela awanele, ngakho kumele siqoqe amarekhodi amanye amasonto futhi sibone ukuthi izinsuku ezinelanga bezizinengi kakhulu kangaki.
